name: c7_frozen
written: 2026-11-07, before any C7 outer-test scoring (round 3 follow-up)
question: Does 'pretrain + calibrate to the person as you go' help? Same EDB folds, same labels, same operating-point and persistence rules as c2_frozen.json (not changed).
calibration_rule: causal, label-free: for each eligible beat, the running MEDIAN over the previous 600 s of that record's eligible beats (needs >=30 beats; same history rule as R1), current beat excluded. No label, episode time or future sample is used.

methods.A1: frozen C2 network (same seed), score minus running median of its own score
methods.A2: frozen C2 network, 16-d pooled features minus their running median, then the frozen final layer (feature-level calibration)
methods.A3: PRIMARY. same architecture, retrained on residual windows = clip(window_int8 - running median window, -128..127); 3 seeds, same optimiser/epochs/early-stop/balancing as c2_frozen; job seed = 1000*fold + seed + 500
methods.M1c: frozen M1 logistic model fed (six features minus their running median)

operating_point: 1% FPR threshold on inner-validation negatives for every method, recomputed on the scored set (t>=60 s, history available, label 0/1)
pass_rule: Calibration ADDS VALUE only if the lower end of the 95% subject-bootstrap range of (A3 mean-of-seeds sens@1%FPR - R1 sens@1%FPR) is above 0. Otherwise: 'no added value shown'. Everything else descriptive.
episode_rule: 24 of last 30 eligible beats above threshold, as in c2_frozen
